svg.aria-label: Animated figure of the ISLES'26 approach: training centers are assigned whole to three folds and a holdout by mixed-integer linear programming that balances lesion characteristics, intensities are clipped at the 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles and z-scored to train three 3D deep-learning models, and at inference their ensemble outlines the stroke lesion on T1-weighted MRI, as applied to about 500 unseen challenge scans
